content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the MANIT Bhopal Temporary Faculty recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date for application submission is not specified, as it is a walk-in recruitment. Candidates should attend the walk-in interview on the scheduled dates.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies for Temporary Faculty at MANIT Bhopal?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies for the post of Temporary Faculty announced by MANIT Bhopal.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Temporary Faculty position?
faq.answer: The salary offered ranges from Rs. 70,000 to Rs. 80,000 per month, depending on the qualification and experience.

faq.question: Q4. What are the minimum educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: The minimum qualifications vary by discipline but generally include a B.Arch./B.Plan. and M.Arch./M.Plan./M.Tech. (first class) with experience, or a Ph.D. in the relevant discipline.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at Maulana Azad National Institute of Technology Bhopal (MANIT Bhopal).

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You should carry all original documents and one set of self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, and experience certificates.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Temporary Faculty posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q9. Are there any age relaxations mentioned for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Age relaxation details are not explicitly mentioned in the provided data. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for specifics.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The job type for these positions is Contractual.
